lines.text: Zechariah lifts up his eyes and sees four chariots coming out from between two mountains of bronze.
The chariots have red, black, white and dappled horses, and all of them are strong.
Zechariah asks the angel what the chariots are, and the angel says they are the four spirits of heaven.
The black horses go north, the white horses go east, and the dappled horses go south.
The eager horses patrol the earth, and the angel summons Zechariah about those going north.
